verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents 'Intuit Intelligence' chat that lets users type natural-language requests to create invoices, resolve anomalies, run payroll, generate reports, and get answers like 'What's driving my profit?' — directly matching the story of operating via NL commands. This is reinforced by a dedicated MCP server exposing 145 tools for AI agents to act on QBO data. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the chat's real-world reliability and accuracy beyond first-party marketing claims.
